description: Uploads one or more new files as attachments of a Rich Page in a single multipart request: `requestBody.resource.data` holds one metadata entry (`fileName`, optional `title`) per file, and `requestBody.files` holds the base64-encoded file bytes at the same array index as each metadata entry. Returns the created attachment IDs. Use this to add files; to change an existing attachment use `patchPageAttachment`, and to list what is already attached use `getPageAttachments`. Effect: creates a new resource. Repeating this call may create additional resources; it is not guaranteed idempotent. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

pageName.description: The Rich Page's ID/name within its space — its stable identifier, not its display title.

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

spaceId.description: The Document Space ID (a folder-like grouping of documents/pages within a project). Use `_default` (no quotes) to address the project's default space.

name: postPageAttachments
